data:
Tesla's fiscal 2024 revenue was about $97.7 billion (up roughly 1% from $96.8 billion in 2023), while NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 revenue, for the year ended January 28, 2024, was about $60.9 billion (up 126% from $27.0 billion the prior year). Tesla was therefore the larger of the two on this basis, at roughly 1.6 times NVIDIA's revenue.

One caveat is that the fiscal calendars differ. NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 ended in January 2024, so it mostly overlaps with Tesla's 2023 calendar year. If you instead compare against NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 (year ended January 26, 2025), revenue was about $130.5 billion, which is roughly 1.3 times Tesla's $97.7 billion, so NVIDIA would be the bigger company in that pairing.
